crossRefs.note: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?
We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this…
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no…

translations.web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
translations.bsb: From where, then, does wisdom come, and where does understanding dwell?
translations.kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
translations.asv: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?
